setting.identity: contemporary Iranian; never generic Arab-world styling
visualContinuity: Use contemporary Tehran as the default city identity: Iranian apartment blocks, parks, shops, sidewalks, buses, taxis, street furniture, and signage shapes.
The Alborz Mountains may appear as the northern backdrop when geography is visible.
Milad Tower is an occasional skyline anchor only when a wide Tehran view makes it plausible; keep its relative direction stable between adjacent scenes.
Do not drift into Gulf, Levantine, North African, Mediterranean-village, European-old-town, fantasy-city, or generic Middle Eastern visual language.
Keep season, weather, time of day, shadows, route direction, recurring architecture, props, and vehicles continuous inside a sequence.

Mina.continuity: same face, age impression, height, body proportions, warm brown eyes, and overall identity throughout
Mina.appearance: Iranian girl with dark brown hair covered by hijab
Mina.clothing: contemporary Iranian modest styles may vary naturally by chapter; outdoor hijab is always present and only a very small amount of hair may show
Mina.familyRule: Mina may appear with her mother, her father, or both; family involvement is preferred over unrelated mixed-gender peer groups

Nino.continuity: same size, proportions, feather color, beak, feet, and identifying feather throughout
Nino.appearance: small soft yellow chicken, orange beak and feet, one small white feather on the left wing
Nino.restrictions: never depict Nino as a cat, black bird, adult hen, duck, or generic chick without the white left-wing feather

Mother.continuity: same face and adult proportions throughout
Mother.appearance: Iranian woman in contemporary modest Iranian hijab
Mother.clothing: wardrobe may vary naturally between contemporary Iranian coat, manteau, knitwear, scarf, and modest casual styles; hijab remains present in public scenes with restrained hair exposure

Father.continuity: same face and adult proportions throughout
Father.appearance: Iranian man with curly dark hair and a short neat beard
Father.clothing: contemporary Iranian casual or smart-casual clothing appropriate to season and location
Father.involvement: include father in family search, planning, travel, or support scenes whenever the story context reasonably allows

Brother.continuity: same face and child proportions throughout
Brother.appearance: younger Iranian boy with curly dark hair
Brother.clothing: contemporary Iranian child clothing appropriate to season and scene

socialRules: Do not stage unrelated boys and girls together as mixed peer groups.
Mina may be shown with her father, mother, or both; ordinary family combinations are allowed.
Adult family members and married adult couples may appear together when the story calls for them.
Prefer family-supported scenes for Mina instead of adding unrelated male peers.
imageRules: Every girl or woman shown in a public/outdoor scene wears hijab; do not depict a girl without hijab.
Do not reveal a large amount of girls' or women's hair; keep visible hair minimal and consistent with the established contemporary Iranian styling.
Use a range of contemporary Iranian hijab and modest clothing styles rather than repeating one identical outfit everywhere.
Do not add a cat as a Nino substitute, clue, portrait, or reunion animal.
Do not show Nino physically present during the chapters in which he is still missing; a printed photo or drawing of him is allowed.
No readable text should be embedded in generated artwork.
Keep recurring faces, Nino's identifying feather, backpacks, vehicles, storefronts, home interiors, parks, and landmarks stable across adjacent scenes.
Use cinematic storybook realism with warm natural light, detailed Iranian environments, and child-friendly emotional expressions.
